entry.title: MapsGL 1.10.2
entry.content: ✨ Features: Add interpolated tropical cyclone layers, which move each storm’s marker smoothly along its past track, current position, and forecast path as the timeline plays, instead of jumping from one advisory point to the next. The track line grows with the marker, a marker stays at each storm’s latest advisory position, and the moving marker and its label draw above the other tropical layers. Variants are available for active storms, invests, and archived storms, as the composites tropical-cyclones-interpolated , tropical-cyclones-icons-interpolated , tropical-cyclones-invests-interpolated , tropical-cyclones-invests-icons-interpolated , tropical-cyclones-archive-interpolated , and tropical-cyclones-archive-icons-interpolated , and as individual position, position icon, name, and track line layers (e.g. tropical-cyclones-positions-interpolated , tropical-cyclones-names-archive-interpolated ). The existing tropical layers are unchanged. controller. addWeatherLayer ( 'tropical-cyclones-icons-interpolated' ); 🐞 Bug Fixes: Fix type declarations that broke in 1.10.0: import { ValueRange } from '@xweather/mapsgl' failed to compile, and ValueRange , Measurement , and FilterExpression were typed as any . Expression , ExpressionValue , and ExpressionOperator are now exported from the package as well. Fix weather layers disappearing, or coming back in the wrong order, after switching the Mapbox basemap style with setStyle() . Fix dispose() on the Mapbox controller throwing Style is not done loading with Mapbox GL v3 when it is called before the style has loaded, for example under React strict mode. Fix paint properties set to 0 being ignored. For example, heatmap.weight , stroke.thickness , and circle.radius now render as 0 instead of falling back to a default. Fix weather layers that share child layers through composites, such as tropical-cyclones and tropical-cyclones-interpolated . Removing one composite no longer removes layers the other still uses. Fix memory use that grew each time a weather layer was added and removed. Fix load:complete never firing again after a source is removed while it is still loading. Fix severe weather alerts staying on the map after the timeline passes their expiration time. Fix icons and labels on time-gated layers, such as tropical cyclone track points, all disappearing at low zoom while the timeline animates. Fix queryFeatures and the data inspector returning features that the timeline has not reached yet and that aren’t drawn on the map. Fix tropical cyclone track line segments appearing one time step early and extending past the last visible track point during animation. Fix the alerts legend failing to display entirely when a single alert is missing its advisory name. Fix vector tile properties that contain JSON-encoded objects or arrays, so filters, expressions, and the data inspector can read their nested values. Improve the detail and sharpness of the pressure-msl and pressure-msl-contour layers. 🛠 Improvements:

entry.title: MapsGL 1.10.0
entry.content: ✨ Features: Add forecast model weather layers : over 400 new layer codes spanning 16 global and regional models ( gfs , gefs , ecmwf-hres , icon , hrdps , adfd , and the regional nbm-* and ndfd-* models). Each model offers the same layer families as the base catalog — temperature, feels like, wind chill, heat index, dew point, humidity, wind speed, direction, barbs and particles, wind gusts, mean sea level pressure, visibility, cloud cover, precipitation rate and accumulation, snow, sleet, ice, snow depth, weather, and radar — addressed as <model>-<layer> . controller. addWeatherLayer ( 'gfs-temperatures' ); controller. addWeatherLayer ( 'nbm-conus-radar' ); controller. addWeatherLayer ( 'hrdps-wind-particles' ); Add layer ordering slots , an opt-in stacking model that places layers into named bands — underlay , inlay , text , and overlay — instead of relying on beforeId alone. Each slot can be pinned below a specific basemap style layer, layers can be moved between slots and ranked within them, and custom slots can be defined. Slots are off by default, so existing stacking behavior is unchanged until you opt in with slots . const controller = new MapboxMapController (map, { account, slots: true }); // pin the whole underlay band below a basemap layer controller. setSlotBeforeId ( 'underlay' , 'waterway-label' ); controller. moveLayerToSlot ( 'my-layer' , 'overlay' ); Add Mapbox Standard slot support so MapsGL ordering slots can be pinned into the basemap’s native bottom , middle , and top bands on Mapbox Standard styles, via setSlotMapboxSlot , getSlotMapboxSlot , usesMapboxStandardSlots , and listMapboxStandardSlots on MapboxMapController . Add setMask for applying, changing, and clearing a layer’s mask at runtime. Masks previously could only be set when a layer was added. It accepts the same mask configuration used by addWeatherLayer , a single mask layer id, or null to clear. controller. setMask ( 'temperatures' , { type: 'land' }); controller. setMask ( 'temperatures' , { layers: [{ id: 'my-region' }], invert: true }); controller. setMask ( 'temperatures' , null ); Add richer data inspector results across the weather layer catalog: colored category badges (air quality index, fire outlook risk, drought severity, earthquake type, river status, UV index band, storm reports and cells, convective outlook risk), progress bars for values like hail probability and wildfire containment, and plain-language reference cues alongside numeric readings (Beaufort force for wind, visibility band, Douglas sea state, dew point comfort, mean sea level pressure band, and sky condition for cloud cover). Format data inspector values in the map’s configured units instead of fixed dual-unit strings, and show the layer’s colorscale swatch next to each sampled value so the reading can be matched to the map. Merge data inspector rows that share a title into a single labeled stats strip, so querying temperature across several models shows one row with a stat per model r

entry.title: MapsGL 1.9.1
entry.content: ✨ Features: Add timeline animation support for tropical cyclone tracks so trackPoint and trackLine features reveal progressively as animation time advances. Add support for ['map-time'] in vector layer filter expressions so feature visibility can be driven directly by the active map timeline position (Unix seconds). controller. addLayer ( 'my-vector-layer' , { filter: [ 'all' , [ '==' , [ 'get' , 'featureType' ], 'trackPoint' ], [ '<=' , [ 'get' , 'timestamp' ], [ 'map-time' ]] ] }); Add ['now'] and ['to-date', …] to the style expression language. ['now'] resolves with wall-clock time at evaluation time and is treated as time-dependent like ['map-time'] , so expressions that use it are deferred to draw time rather than evaluated in the worker. ['to-date', value] coerces a sub-expression to a Date using the same rules as elsewhere in the library, which enables date comparisons and arithmetic inside filters and paint. filter : [ '<' , [ 'get' , 'expires' ], [ 'now' ]]]; // or compare two dates [ '>' , [ 'to-date' , [ 'get' , 'start' ]], [ 'to-date' , [ 'get' , 'end' ]]]; When an expression evaluates to a plain object, nested expression arrays in that object are evaluated recursively. That allows structured paint values (for example icon width and height) to be returned from let and similar forms instead of requiring imperative callbacks. Add an opt-in preloadLowQuality flag on layer and weather layer data options (default false ) so applications can choose whether to preload low-resolution tiles for immediate pan and zoom fallback, instead of always issuing those requests. map. addLayer ( 'my-tile-layer' , { source: 'my-source' , preloadLowQuality: true , paint: { /* ... */ } }); controller. addWeatherLayer ( 'precip' , { data: { preloadLowQuality: true } }); 🐞 Bug Fixes: Fix stale or expired tiles being selected for level-of-detail fallback and rendering, which could show outdated data before reload completes. Fix wrapped tile coordinate filtering at zoom 0 when world copies are disabled so valid dateline tiles continue rendering. Fix source metadata request handling by preventing concurrent getMetadata races, canceling stale pending requests before reload, and restoring token refresh behavior after metadata optimizations. Fix vector feature querying so results respect active layer filters and reduced minZoom / maxZoom ranges. Fix vector feature queries returning features from the wrong tile store by limiting results to the data store owned by the queried layer. Fix legacy vector filter compatibility by migrating older filter syntax to Mapbox-style expression format. Fix radar archive valid-time reduction so the newest archive interval remains available when loading timeline data. Fix time series tile loading for hidden layers that other layers depend on (for example a hidden query source sampled by a data query layer) so dependent layers receive data instead of staying empty. Fix dynamic GeoJSON tile layers flickering during rapid updates by keep

entry.title: MapsGL 1.9.0
entry.content: ✨ Features: Add support for animating vector layers, e.g. lightning-strikes , alerts , stormreports , etc. Add Mapbox-style expressions for styles and filters, including regular expression matching, to-locale-string , and to-unit for unit conversion. Text layers now use expressions in text.value instead of the previous property , measurement , and transform fields. paint : { text : [{ value: [ 'to-unit' , [ 'get' , 'ob.tempC' ], 'temperature' , 'C' , 'F' , 1 ], size: 20 , color: '#fff' }] } controller. addWeatherLayer ( 'alerts' , { filter: [ 'regex' , '.(W|EX)$' , [ 'get' , 'VTEC' ]] }); Add minZoom and maxZoom on layer specifications so layer visibility follows the map zoom range. map. addLayer ( 'my-layer' , { minZoom: 4 , maxZoom: 12 , // ... }); Add showCoordinates on the data inspector control so you can hide coordinate rows while still showing queried feature values. map. addDataInspectorControl ({ event: 'move' , showCoordinates: false }); Show alert colors directly in data inspector results for alerts layers. 🐞 Bug Fixes: Fix viewport bounds when maps are rotated, pitched, narrow, or intersect the anti-meridian. Fix screen pixel coordinates not being properly converted to map coordinates at medium to high zoom levels when map is in globe projection. Fix wrapped tile coordinate handling when world copies are disabled so valid wrapped tiles are not dropped. Fix vector tile refresh when multiple layers share a source or when a consumer is added while tiles are still loading. Refresh vector time series data for shared sources and keep animator state aligned when series intervals change. Fix contour interpolation when smoothing scales are applied so contours align across tile boundaries. Fix encoded raster and grid sampling so edge padding and color value ranges are applied correctly. 🛠 Improvements: Improve rendering performance by reducing total draw calls. Improve encoded raster operation processing throughput for derived tile data. Improve time series memory behavior with LRU-based interval cache management and targeted interval clearing. Improve symbol placement quality by refining collision sorting and cross-tile symbol behavior. Preserve timeline position when visible range changes. Improve contour interval scaling to better align with source data resolution and interval style configuration.

Improve performance of rapid GeoJSON data source updates, which is primarily applicable to all *-text* layers and their value updates during timeline changes and animation. Improve snow accumulation calculations for snow and snow-accum layers. Improve particle density and speed consistency across zoom levels, especially fractional zoom levels. entry.title: MapsGL 1.8.0
entry.content: With this release, both Mapbox and MapLibre globe are now supported! 🌎🌏 ✨ Features: Add support for both Mapbox and MapLibre globe projections. This allows for seamless globe rendering with both mapping libraries, enabling a more immersive 3D experience when viewing global weather data. Support globe-to-mercator projection transitions according to the underlying mapping library’s projection state and transition. Add DayNightOverlay layer for depicting night, civil twilight, nautical twilight, and astronomical twilight on the map. Use MapController#addDayNightOverlay and MapController#removeDayNightOverlay to add and remove the overlay from the map. Add lightning-strikes-pulse and alerts-short-fuse weather layers. Add paint.animated layer style property to control whether a layer should continuously animate. This is useful for layers whose shaders have special effects that animate and are controlled by the overall elapsed time. 🛠 Improvements: Improve GeoJSON data source update and rendering performance. Improve map-pitched (aligned) symbols to ensure symbols are always rendered in the correct orientation relative to the map. 🐞 Bug Fixes: Cache weather layers by their custom identifiers when provided in the addWeatherLayer options. Fix an issue when converting between screen coordinates (pixels) and map coordinates. Fix symbol-specific opacity not being used when rendering. Fix rendering issues when using Leaflet or Google Maps mapping libraries. Deprecate the lightning-strike-heat weather layer code in favor of lightning-strikes-heat for consistent naming with other lightning layers.

entry.content: Aeris Core Minor updates, bug fixes and documentation updates. AerisMap On pan/zoom, clear existing markers after load of new ones. Polygons split into their own category. An addLayer(AerisPolygonData) has been added to AerisMapView. Minor updates, bug fixes and documentation updates. Demo App Updates to the readme Notification bar correctly updating in Demo app at 15 minute intervals at screen on Demo of custom endpoint in the package com.example.customendpoint Places search support for example of searching locations using Aeris Places endpoint and edittext view in com.example.demoaerisproject.LocationSearchActivity Storing searched places example in com.example.db package and com.example.demoaerisproject.MyLocsActivity.
